talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reaped.0: A horn went in the night, out past the fields. Low, like it came up out of the ground. Nobody here owns a horn.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reaped.1: The pillagers have gone quiet this side of the hills. You'd think that was good news. The carter says they're burying their own, and then burying them again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reaped.2: My cousin saw grey coats on the road at dusk, marching in step. Said their arms just hung. He didn't stop to see the faces.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reaped.3: Something went over the palisade at the old camp. Not through the gate. Over. On too many legs, with a rider.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.chat.re: Krel fell at the ford. I saw it. Three nights on he walked into camp with his arms hanging. We do not say his name now.
We burn our dead this season. Before, we did not. Ask no more.
A horn in the dark that is not ours. When you hear it, you are already late.
